scripts.build:prod: npm run -w @aidrive/shared build && npm run -w @aidrive/sdk build && npm run -w @aidrive/api build && npm run -w @aidrive/web build
scripts.dev:stop: sh -c '(pkill -f "next dev" || true); (pkill -f "tsx watch src/server.ts" || true); (lsof -ti tcp:3000 | xargs kill -9) 2>/dev/null || true; (lsof -ti tcp:4000 | xargs kill -9) 2>/dev/null || true; (lsof -ti tcp:4100 | xargs kill -9) 2>/dev/null || true'
scripts.dev:reset: npm run -w @aidrive/web clean && npm run dev
